scope: Selected detailed primary-source claim audits plus a separately complete pinned OpenAI metadata catalogue. Not a complete survey of all AI mathematics.

claims.title: All mathematical problems have been solved
claims.provider_or_author: No identified primary source asserts a defensible universal result
claims.model_or_version: Not applicable
claims.statement: No. A catalogue or benchmark cannot establish universal mathematical solvability.
scope_and_assumptions: A finite release contains selected statements; mathematical domains and problem formulations remain distinct.
claims.human_contribution: This is the atlas interpretation, not an attribution to either company.

evidence.access_depth: current label and problem summary inspected

claims.external_verification: No universal certification identified.
limitations: Even verified headline theorems do not settle all related conjectures.

claims.title: Gemini Deep Think: IMO 2025 gold-standard performance

claims.title: Planar unit distances: polynomial construction improvement
claims.model_or_version: Research model; no commercial model identifier inferred
claims.statement: There is δ>0 and infinitely many n for which ν(n)≥n^(1+δ).
scope_and_assumptions: ν(n) counts the largest number of unordered Euclidean unit-distance pairs among n planar points.
claims.human_contribution: Human-edited exposition; external mathematicians reviewed and strengthened parts.

evidence.access_depth: 18-page PDF; Theorem 1.1 and construction outline inspected

claims.external_verification: Expert confirmation is described by the manuscript and announcement; no independent local derivation of the full construction.
limitations: Disproves the old near-linear conjectural scale; does not find the exact extremal function.
